summary: Search does not support package identifier.
claim: Search does not support package identifier.

evidence.source: catalog_fts Fts4 table in Databases.kt has columns brand, material, product, color_name only; package_id is absent. MainViewModel.search() builds an FTS query only against those columns.

suggested_remediation: Add package_id to the FTS index or implement a separate exact package lookup integrated with search.
suggested_validation: Enter a known package ID in the search field and verify matching catalog entries are returned.
